system.name: Cocoon
system.one_liner: a system architecture for differentially private training that splits and stores a large correlated-noise history across GPU, main memory, and CXL memory

components.name: Preprocessing Phase
components.role: grouping for the noise pre-computation and coalescing stage that runs before training

components.name: Noise Pre-compute & Coalesce (§4.1)
components.role: computes and coalesces correlated noise ahead of training on the GPU

components.name: Coalesced Noise
components.role: compact noise output of the preprocessing stage, stored on the CPU

components.name: CPU
components.role: main-memory host holding coalesced noise when CXL memory can be avoided

components.name: GPU
components.role: device running DP training (Emb, DNN) and combining noise from all three sources

components.name: DP Training
components.role: differentially private training region combining embedding and DNN computation with noise

components.name: Emb
components.role: embedding component of the trained model

components.name: DNN
components.role: deep neural network component of the trained model

components.name: NMP (§4.2)
components.role: near-memory processing that produces noise directly from the CXL memory when the noise history spills there

components.name: CXL Mem
components.role: CXL-attached memory device holding the remaining noise history and performing NMP

components.name: Distributed Noise History
components.role: legend listing the three noise sources (①GPU, ②CPU, ③CXL Mem) that together hold the full noise history

content.key_idea: Cocoon partitions the noise history heuristically across GPU/main memory and CXL memory, keeping it entirely off CXL when possible so the GPU can focus on training, and only spilling to CXL near-memory processing when the noise history is too large.
content.reading_order: Left to right: preprocessing phase and CPU coalescing feed into the central GPU DP-training box, which also draws GPU-local noise and CXL near-memory-processed noise from the Distributed Noise History panel on the right.

summary: This figure gives the system overview of Cocoon, an architecture for differentially private training with correlated noise. It shows noise generated and combined from three distributed sources, marked with circled numbers 1-3 and cross-referenced in a 'Distributed Noise History' panel on the right: GPU-local noise (1), CPU-coalesced noise precomputed in a preprocessing phase (2, via §4.1 Noise Pre-compute & Coalesce), and CXL-memory near-memory-processed noise (3, via §4.2 NMP). All three are combined through GEMV operations into a DP Training region on the GPU that trains an embedding (Emb) and DNN model. The paper text confirms Cocoon uses a heuristic to partition the noise history, favoring GPU/main memory and placing history on CXL memory only when it does not fit, to keep the GPU focused on training. The diagram is a host-device box diagram with square-cornered flat-colored boxes for CPU, GPU and CXL Mem, dashed borders marking the DP Training sub-region and the noise-history legend, and circled numbers linking distributed hardware components to the legend.
summary_zh: 该图展示 Cocoon 系统架构概览：噪声分别由 GPU（①）、CPU 预处理合并（②，§4.1）和 CXL 内存近存处理（③，§4.2）生成，通过 GEMV 汇总进入 GPU 上的差分隐私训练（Emb、DNN），右侧图例以圈码对应三个来源；正文说明系统优先使用 GPU/主存，仅在必要时才使用 CXL 内存。
